title: Schedule of Traveller Name Correction Charges — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A misspelled traveller name on an issued ticket is corrected at the fee stated for the fare brand held, and only so far as the stated number of characters. Beyond that number of characters a new ticket is required. The sheet below prices both lines across the seven brands of Air Ticket Fare Brands.

| Fare brand | Name correction on an issued ticket, USD | Characters that may be corrected before a new ticket is required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0.00 | 0 |
| Economy Saver | 85.00 | 3 |
| Economy Classic | 65.00 | 3 |
| Economy Flex | 45.00 | 4 |
| Premium Economy Select | 35.00 | 4 |
| Business Saver | 25.00 | 5 |
| Business Flex | 0.00 | 5 |

Annotations. Under Business Saver a correction touching 5 characters falls within the limit and a correction touching 6 characters requires a new ticket; the same reading gives 3 characters under Economy Saver and Economy Classic and 4 under Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select. Basic Economy Lite stands at 0 characters, so no name correction is made on a ticket issued under it. The fee is priced at 0.00 under Business Flex and falls across the brands from the 85.00 of Economy Saver to the 25.00 of Business Saver.
